review_limits.profile_boundary: RealFile::read_all now obtains len before entering VFS_READ in read_all_with_observed_length. Previously len was inside that span. Span reduction therefore cannot wholly be called read acceleration; metadata stage/context and actual IO calls must be compared separately.
review_limits.hot_cache_capacity_formula: Raw B + page P + canonical B/64 + decoded B/16 + whole B/64. Existing derived caches are separately configured without subtracting from raw B. This change scales all those existing capacities; adds no new pool.
review_limits.default_capacity_fraction_of_headroom: B=H/16 P=H/32 => (1+3/32)*B+P = 51/512 H, approximately 9.9609375%, subject to legacy floors.
review_limits.dual_max_override_fraction_of_headroom: B=P=H/4 => 67/128 H, approximately 52.34375%, subject to legacy floors.
review_limits.memory_limits: These are per-cache configured accounted capacities and populate on demand, not eagerly reserved RSS. They do not prove a whole-process RSS bound or include all other caches, retained borrows, metadata or temporary work.
